a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to build to 8 gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve holds just enough for one unit, so I'm proposing we change the deal. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you take too, the split is random and we likely both fail. I'm telling you plainly so you can decide with full information.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry. With storms this likely, the original plan almost surely meant neither of us survives. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so the reserve can rebuild toward your 4.
